d53d0467370a09751dbd40e73f9dc010.final_output: To prepare for AI PM interviews, practice with a human who can provide realistic feedback and "push back" during mock conversations. AI tools are not sufficient as they are often too agreeable and fail to provide the necessary calibration needed for effective interview preparation. [Source 1]

metas.title: How to prepare for AI PM interviews
metas.author: Suhas Motwani (TPF Weekly)
